J&J's gross margin in fiscal Q2 2023 (the quarter ended July 2, 2023) was about 67.8%. This comes from the company's 10-Q.

- Sales to customers were $25,530 million.
- Cost of products sold was $8,212 million.
- Gross profit was therefore $17,318 million, and $17,318 million ÷ $25,530 million is 67.8%.

For comparison, Q2 2022 gross margin was 67.0%.
